entries.title: Use up to 3 healing items.
entries.meaning: Use no more than three recovery items in battle; exclude cooking items and uses by support units.

entries.title: Land the first hit.
entries.meaning: An allied unit must land the first attack across both sides.

entries.title: Summon Assist: defeat foe.
entries.meaning: Defeat at least one enemy with Summon Assist.

entries.title: No KOs below your level.
entries.meaning: Do not defeat enemies below the attacker level; equal level allowed. SPOT and Assist participants do not count for the level comparison.

entries.title: No allies knocked out.
entries.meaning: No allied incapacitations. Automatic Blade Awakening counts. Voluntary Blade Awakening and incapacitation avoided through Utsusemi or support do not count. KO saves means incapacitation prevention; manual means voluntary Blade Awakening.
